Breakfast Buffet

Fuel your morning with flavours from around the world.

Weekdays: 6.30am - 10.00am | Weekends & Public Holidays: 6.30am - 10.30am

Price: $45++

Start your morning with a generous breakfast buffet in Singapore featuring a wide variety of international and local flavours, thoughtfully prepared to suit every palate. From light and healthy options to hearty morning favourites, our breakfast spread is designed to give guests a balanced and satisfying start to the day.

Whether you prefer fresh fruits, baked pastries, warm dishes, or Asian-inspired selections, the breakfast buffet offers an extensive mix of global cuisines in one convenient dining experience. Guests can enjoy a relaxed morning setting with an ever-changing selection that reflects seasonal ingredients and chef-curated highlights.

A Balanced Morning Dining Experience

Our breakfast buffet brings together a curated selection of dishes across multiple categories, ensuring something for everyone:

  • Fresh seasonal fruits and light bites
  • Assorted breads, pastries and breakfast bakery selections
  • Cereals, yoghurts and wholesome breakfast bowls
  • Cold selections including salads and lighter proteins
  • Warm cooked dishes featuring international and Asian-inspired flavours
  • Live stations offering freshly prepared breakfast favourites
  • Traditional local morning staples alongside global classicsRefreshing juices, teas and morning beverages

Each section is designed to provide variety while maintaining a focus on freshness, quality, and comfort.

Ideal for Hotel Guests and Weekend Dining

Perfect for both hotel guests and weekend visitors, the breakfast buffet offers a calm and welcoming dining environment ideal for families, business travellers, and leisure diners. It is a convenient way to enjoy a full breakfast without the need to choose from a single menu item, allowing guests to explore a wide range of flavours in one sitting.

Why Choose Our Breakfast Buffet

  • Wide international selection suitable for diverse preferences
  • Freshly prepared dishes replenished throughout service hours
  • Comfortable dining ambience ideal for morning meals
  • Options catering to lighter, healthier and indulgent choices
  • Consistent quality from a halal-certified kitchen

Designed as more than just a meal, the breakfast buffet experience brings together convenience, variety and quality in a single sitting. Whether you are starting a busy workday or enjoying a leisurely morning, it offers a reliable and satisfying breakfast option in the heart of the city.

Frequently Asked Questions

All food prepared and served in Royal Plaza on Scotts and Carousel is certified Halal by Majlis Ugama Islam Singapura (MUIS). The Halal certifications apply to all open kitchen food stations in Carousel and all kitchens of the hotel. These also include the food served in the hotel’s room service and banquet functions.

The certifications are under the “Eating Establishment Scheme (Food Station)”, with strict control measures in place, operators are allowed to serve alcoholic beverages.
